base: black-and-white editorial vintage documentary photograph, desaturated, high contrast, heavy film grain, mid-century mountaineering and expedition archive look. Universe: mountains, rock faces, ropes, climbers, porters, alpine terrain, summits. COMPOSITION: the subject sits low, in the lower third of the frame, with foreground bleeding off the bottom edge; the ENTIRE UPPER HALF of the image is bright, pale, empty and hazy (open pale sky or mist), fading to near-white at the very top edge for clean compositing. No text, no words, no numbers, no logos, no emojis, no gradients, no added color, no modern stock-photo look, no digital sharpness.

images.scene: A mountain expedition porter bent double under an enormous towering load lashed to his back at the base of a mountain, drenched in sweat, straining with immense physical effort, head down, utterly exhausted. He is low in the frame with rocky ground bleeding off the bottom; the pale hazy sky fills the whole upper half.

A laborer swinging a heavy sledgehammer to break rock, arms taut with raw brute effort, dust and chips flying, muscles straining, the hardest manual labor there is, sweat pouring. He is low in the frame with broken stone bleeding off the bottom; the pale empty sky fills the upper half.

An exhausted worker sitting alone on rocks at dusk, empty-handed, shoulders slumped in deep fatigue, a vast mountain still looming unclimbed behind him. He sits low in the frame; the pale hazy sky fills the entire upper half.

A forked trail at the base of a mountain: one flat safe path winding along the valley floor, and one steep exposed ridge climbing sharply up the peak; a single small lone figure standing at the fork deciding. The paths and figure are in the lower half; the pale empty sky fills the whole upper half.

A man frantically digging and shoveling into the ground at the base of the mountain, his back turned to the towering peak, busy and sweating hard but going nowhere, buried in labor to avoid the climb. He is low in the frame; the pale hazy sky fills the upper half.

A lone climber clinging to a sheer vertical rock face with great exposure and empty air all around him, fully committed to a hard move far above the ground, tiny against the immense cliff. He is low-to-mid in the frame with the rock face bleeding off the bottom; the pale hazy open sky and air fill the entire upper half.

Close view of a climber's weathered hands carefully checking and tightening a knot and steel carabiner on a climbing rope, deliberate and precise, gear laid out. The hands, rope and pale rock are low in the frame; the upper half is bright, pale and empty.

A mountaineer at base camp crouched studying a route map spread open on a flat rock, with instruments, compass and coiled rope beside him, a headlamp lighting the map, planning the ascent carefully before dawn. He is low in the frame; the pale hazy sky fills the upper half.

A lone figure standing on a mountain summit at dawn seen from behind, looking out over a vast sunlit range of peaks and clouds far below, resolute and triumphant. He stands low in the lower third of the frame; the ENTIRE upper two-thirds of the image is bright, pale, open sky and haze, fading to near-white at the top.
